name: Christmas Morning Egg, Sausage & Cheese Breakfast Casserole vs. Orange Rolls (Citrus Warning)
whyItWorks: Overnight egg, bread/hashbrown, ham, and aged cheddar breakfast strata ("Wife Saver") and classic cinnamon rolls are warm, low-fiber Christmas morning traditions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake your Christmas morning casserole with eggs, ham/turkey sausage, bread/hashbrowns, and cheddar (no bell peppers or onions), and bake Classic Cinnamon Rolls instead of Utah Orange Rolls (which contain orange zest/juice in the frosting).
watchOuts: CITRUS AVOID: Traditional Utah Christmas Orange Rolls use grated orange peel/zest and orange juice—stick to Cinnamon Rolls!
